parsedVerdict.reasoning: All three files deal with one thing: the HTTP adapter boundary. createApp.ts builds the Express app and wires the routers, the not-found handler and the error handler. requestFields.ts checks untrusted request bodies at the HTTP edge. BadRequestError.ts defines the HTTP-specific error that requestFields.ts throws and that errorHandler.ts (outside this module) turns into a response. Each validation rule lives in one place: requiredString reuses optionalString instead of repeating the string-type check, and every validation failure goes through the shared BadRequestError instead of building errors or responses ad hoc. Nothing bypasses the module's own pieces: createApp uses the shared middleware, and the controllers use requestFields.
